about: The religion with the most followers in each country, by country id, for the question "Which religion has the most followers in X?". It is the largest religion among people who have one, so a country where most people have none still has an answer. Countries where two religions are close, where the figures disagree, or where religions overlap are listed under `skip` with the reason and are never asked. `rivals` lists the other religions with a large following in a country: they are the most tempting wrong options, so they are offered first. `unsure` marks answers worth double-checking. Every country must appear once, under a religion or under `skip`. Edit, then run `npm run derive`.

skip.ERI: Christianity and Islam are close to half each.
skip.NGA: Islam and Christianity are close to half each.
skip.TCD: Islam leads Christianity by a small margin.
skip.CIV: Islam and Christianity are within a few points of each other.
skip.GNB: Islam, traditional religions and Christianity: the figures vary widely by source.
skip.TGO: Christianity and traditional religions: the figures vary widely by source.
skip.MDG: Christianity and traditional religions: sources disagree on which is larger.
skip.BIH: Islam and Christianity (Orthodox and Catholic together) are close to half each.
skip.CHN: Folk religion, Buddhism and no religion overlap; no clear largest religion.
skip.HKG: Buddhism, Taoism and folk religion overlap; no clear largest religion.
skip.TWN: Buddhism and Taoism are close, and overlap.
skip.JPN: Shinto and Buddhism are practised together by most people.
skip.VNM: Folk religion, Buddhism and no religion overlap; the figures vary widely by source.
skip.VAT: The answer is the country itself.

unsure.KOR: Most South Koreans have no religion. Among those who do, Protestants and Catholics together outnumber Buddhists.
unsure.TZA: No census has asked about religion since 1967; surveys put Christians at about 60%.
unsure.BEN: Christianity is a little under half; Islam and Vodun follow.
unsure.ALB: Islam is the largest by background (about half in the census); many Albanians are not observant.
unsure.LBN: Muslims (Sunni and Shia together) are about two thirds; Christians about one third. No census since 1932.
unsure.SUR: Christianity is just under half; Hinduism and Islam follow.
unsure.MUS: Hinduism is just under half; Christianity and Islam follow.
unsure.SGP: Buddhism is the largest at about a third; Christianity, Islam and no religion follow.
unsure.CZE: Most Czechs have no religion; Christianity is the largest among those who do.
unsure.EST: Most Estonians have no religion; Christianity is the largest among those who do.
unsure.NLD: Most Dutch people have no religion; Christianity is the largest among those who do.
unsure.MKD: Christianity (Orthodox) is the largest; Islam is about a third.
unsure.ETH: Orthodox and Protestant Christians together are about two thirds; Islam about a third.
